suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document Windows-specific fallbacks in the skill procedure: (1) `rg` may not be available in the Execute shell on Windows — use PowerShell `Select-String` as fallback; (2) `.factory/init.sh` is bash-only — Windows workers should read the script and apply commands manually or skip init for deletion-only tasks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features delete-claude-md-files and consolidate-docs both deviated from the skill procedure due to Windows incompatibilities. Workers successfully adapted but had to discover workarounds independently.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Note that `.factory/init.sh` initialization is optional for pure-deletion tasks that don't require dependency installation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature delete-claude-md-files worker skipped init.sh and successfully completed the deletion task without it. The skill procedure treats init as mandatory.
